demos.title: Riso separation lab
demos.summary: Drop in an image and pull it apart into risograph inks: pick inks, tune each separation, stack filters, choose halftone screens and misregistration, then export the layers for print.

demos.title: Windchime
demos.summary: A physically simulated wind chime in fractal wind. Tune the chimes, change the materials and the sky, and share your chime as a link.

demos.title: Video overlay editor
demos.summary: Composite video, stills, three.js avatars and speech bubbles on a keyframed timeline, then export MP4 or WebM straight from the browser.

demos.title: Paisl
demos.summary: An interactive Apollonian-gasket paisley generator with symmetry, colour and packing controls, and SVG export.

demos.title: Squid
demos.summary: A three.js generative, procedural, seamlessly looping tentacle animation.

demos.title: X-Fade
demos.summary: A fluid, randomly looping ambient soundscape: clips shuffle and crossfade forever.
